title: WRealTime
description: RealTime is a Minecraft plugin that synchronizes the in-game time with the real-world time.
body:
RealTime is a modern Minecraft plugin that synchronizes the in-game time with the real system time.
If it’s night outside, it will also be night in your Minecraft world—and when the sun rises, a new day begins in the game.

This creates a realistic and immersive day-and-night cycle that makes your world feel more alive.

✨ Features


🌍 Synchronization of Minecraft time with real-world time

🌅 Realistic day and night cycle

🔄 Toggle on and off via command

⚙️ Easy setup

🚀 Performance optimized

🧩 Compatible with Paper and Spigot


.




⌨️ Commands

Enables real-time synchronization


```
/realtime true
```



Disables real-time synchronization


```
/realtime false
```
